subject: Post-discovery: 30-min product demo — scheduling options
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Harris <jordan.harris@silverline.com>, Samira Patel <samira.patel@silverline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: 30-min product demo — scheduling options

Hi Jordan and Samira —

Thanks again for the convo earlier today — really appreciate you walking through Silverline's near-term priorities. Quick recap from our side: 

- Primary use case: realtime risk-scoring and contextual customer support scripts (low-latency inference, on-prem for sensitive PII).
- Key constraints: SOC 2 evidence, VPC/private deployment option, predictable throughput for peak batch windows.
- Success metric: 30% reduction in average time-to-decision for manual reviews + <=50ms median token latency on routed requests.

We'd love to show a short 30-minute product demo (high-level UX + one technical slide on integration options) followed by a 15-minute optional technical deep-dive if your engineers want to stay. To make scheduling easy, here are a few options (all in ET / PT):

Option A — Tue Mar 23, 10:00–10:30 ET (7:00–7:30 PT)
Option B — Wed Mar 24, 11:00–11:30 ET (8:00–8:30 PT)
Option C — Thu Mar 25, 14:00–14:30 ET (11:00–11:30 PT)

Suggested attendees from Silverline: Product (Jordan), Security (Samira), 1x Engineer (Ravi) -- that's enough to cover both product fit and integration. From our side I'll bring Marissa (solutions/CS) and a tech lead (Aditya) for the optional deep-dive.

I've attached a short demo deck and a one-page pre-demo checklist so your team can pick which integration scenario you'd like to see. If you confirm a time, I'll send a calendar invite and a brief agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments:
- redwood-demo-deck.pdf (presentation, 8 slides)
- pre-demo-checklist.docx (checklist, 1 page)
From: Jordan Harris <jordan.harris@silverline.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samira Patel <samira.patel@silverline.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T18:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: 30-min product demo — scheduling options

Thanks Vanessa — this was super helpful.

Option B (Wed Mar 24, 11:00–11:30 ET) works best for us. I'll plan to have Samira (security) join and I'll invite Ravi (engineering) to the call as well.

Two quick asks before we lock it in:
1) Can you include a 5-minute section on deployment options (hosted vs. private/VPC)? That's one of our key decision points.
2) Is there a short agenda you can include in the calendar invite?

If that time works, please send the invite and I'll accept.

Appreciate it — Jordan
Jordan Harris
Product Lead, Silverline Financial
jordan.harris@silverline.com

Agenda (30 min):
- 0–5m: Introductions and goal check
- 5–20m: Live demo — inference & routing, batching, and cost controls
- 20–25m: Deployment options (hosted API, Dedicated, Private/VPC)
- 25–30m: Next steps & Q&A

Calendar link (invite sent): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
Drive: short demo deck: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-redwood-demo

Aditya — tagging you to confirm availability for the optional technical deep-dive (we may ask you to stay on for ~15 minutes after the demo). Marissa — I’ll loop you for pre-demo setup and note-taking.

Jordan/Samira — see you Wed the 24th. If anything changes, let me know and we can move quickly.

Best,
Vanessa
